headline: Steady miles, but the climbing week slipped
body:
That 14.3 miles at 444 feet is a fine easy hour — it keeps the legs turning, but it doesn't move either axis. Here's the honest read with 34 days left. Distance: your longest is 27.7 miles, under half of 62, and this week landed at 45.7 miles after 68.8 the week before. Climbing is the bigger gap. This week's 1,209 feet is well down from 2,923, and your best single day, 1,819 feet, is still less than Gibraltar's 2,551 — which you'll hit after 30-plus miles, on the clock, inside a 6,600-foot day.

So the next three weeks need long rides and foothill feet, not more flat hours. Thursday is the pick for climbing — 74 degrees, wind at 6. Saturday suits a long push toward 35–40 miles; it's 80, so roll out near the 6:44 sunrise. Monday or Tuesday, spin easy or rest. No rain anywhere this week.
